falsifier: The campaign is invalid on any sealed integrity, identity, access-order, parity, clock, settlement, repeatability, or negative-control defect. Otherwise a whole C book is PROMOTE_TO_SHADOW only when both paired yield lower bounds and both selected-side accuracy-minus-0.5 lower bounds are strictly positive, C has at least 50 settled scheduled trades per side, activity is at least 80% of A and B, and both months pass the sealed whole-book guardrails. Adequately sampled C is RETAIN_V1 when the C-A yield upper bound is negative or either C-side accuracy-minus-0.5 upper bound is non-positive. All other valid outcomes, including ordinary sparsity or genuine zero standard error, are INCONCLUSIVE. No retrospective result activates a book.
